t: This is Schreiber House, with its attached swimming pool, in Camden. It was designed by the architect James Gowan, a Scottish-born designer known for a post-modernist, engineering style that influenced a generation of British architects. It was commissioned by Chaim Schreiber, a Polish-born furniture manufacturer who founded Schreiber Furniture in 1957. The house and pool are listed, which says something about how highly the design is regarded.
